column1: # The normalization table of the parity harness (ADR-draft-parity-harness-with-variants), read by
# scripts/check-parity.sh. One row per bash message, three or four fields separated by tabs: an
# extended regular expression the message after "  - " matches; the rule ID of nuc it maps to;
# "line" when the bash message names a line, "-" when it names none and the comparison leaves the
# line out; and "=<path>" for the file nuc names in place of the bash's location, or "+<prefix>"
# before it. A rule's first row sets the mode for all its findings. A bash message no row matches
# is a difference, so a ported rule brings its rows, and a check that is not ported yet is caught
# when it fires on a tree of the corpus.
# check-docs.sh, check 14: the template release named.
^README\.md: no '\*\*Template release:\*\*' line
^README\.md: the Template release line names neither
# check-docs.sh, check 1: the ADR index.
^ADR index not found: docs/adr/README\.md$
^ADR index: row for [^ ]+ links to
^ADR index: row for [^ ]+ is .+ but sits (above|below) the 'Superseded and rejected' heading
^ADR index: lists '.*' twice
^ADR index: file '.*' exists but is not listed in the index$
^ADR index: lists '.*', but no such ADR file exists$
^ADR index: status for '.*' is .* in the index but .* in the file$
^ADR index: 'Applies to' for '.*' is '.*' in the index but '.*' in the file$
^[^ :]+: no '\*\*Status:\*\*' line with a status emoji found$
^[^ :]+: no '\*\*Applies to:\*\*' line naming what the decision constrains$
# check-docs.sh, check 2: the ADR numbering.
^ADR numbering: expected '[0-9]{4}-\*\.md' at position [0-9]+, found
^[^ :]+: heading says '.*', but the filename says ADR-
^[^ :]+: a draft's slug is lower case letters and digits joined by single hyphens$
# check-docs.sh, check 7: the ADR headers; the stray field names its line, the others none.
^[^ :]+:[0-9]+: a header field not written as the list item
^[^ :]+: status line carries [0-9]+ status emoji
^[^ :]+: status line reads
^[^ :]+: still carries the instruction paragraph from template\.md
